decisions.choice: Built the screen from installed components (Card, ToggleGroup, Field, Input, Select, Button, Badge, Empty) instead of adapting a block.
decisions.why: Build-a-screen says to adapt a block when its structure matches the product. CRM 01's workspace sidebar, tabs and activity feed don't match a one-screen pantry tool, so composing components was the first step that fit.

decisions.choice: The stock list is a vertical ToggleGroup with one controlled value, so each row is a button with aria-pressed.
options: Table with a select action per row
decisions.why: It is the pattern Ultima's own CRM 01 block uses for 'select a row, show its record', and it brings roving focus and pressed state without extra ARIA or key handlers.

decisions.choice: The category control is a portalled Select inside an inline form. The form does not open in a Dialog.
decisions.why: The form stays visible at the intake desk. Select portals to body, where the root CSS theme reaches it, and Base UI handles keyboard opening, Escape and focus return.

decisions.choice: Put the 48rem breakpoint in the app token module (src/components/pantry/screen.stylex.ts) with stylex.defineConsts, next to a defineVars group holding --app-size-content-max.
options: Named module constant in pantry.tsx, as Ultima's principles and the Projects lesson do
defineConsts in the app's own .stylex.ts token module
decisions.why: Ultima says a breakpoint lives as a constant in the file that uses it. The brief says the app decides no lengths outside its theme and token modules, so the length goes in the token module and the screen reads it from there.

decisions.choice: Overrode the ToggleGroup row's pressed background to --ult-color-accent-subtle, with a sibling ':is([data-pressed]):hover' key, and set the 'Larder' eyebrow in --ult-color-accent-text.
decisions.why: Inside a Card, the default pressed color is the same as the Card surface, so the selected row disappeared. Accent-subtle shows the selection in the brand color without changing what status colors mean.

decisions.choice: Accepted the documented font fallback instead of loading Figtree or IBM Plex Mono.
options: Load the named faces in the app (for example a font package)
decisions.why: The export names the faces but loads no files. Loading them would add a dependency the guidance doesn't supply, and the docs say accepting the fallback is acceptable.

decisions.choice: Kept @stylexjs/eslint-plugin at 0.19.1 and @stylexjs/stylex at init's pinned 0.19.0.
